jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Specialist AI Tooling, Specialist Technology Team, AWS Specialist Technology Team (STT)
jobs.description: AWS Specialist Technology Team (STT) is seeking a Software Development Engineer to join the Specialist AI Tooling engineering team - the group building AI-native, agentic solutions that are fundamentally transforming how thousands of AWS technical specialists and field team members develop expertise, get matched to customer engagements, and how AWS service teams consume customer feedback at scale. If you want to build production agentic AI systems that impact thousands of users daily - not research prototypes, but real AI agents solving real problems - this is the role for you. You will design, build, and operate core components across four interconnected products that collectively power the intelligence layer of AWS's specialist ecosystem: AWS Learning Agent - A new generative AI-powered, agentic learning system that replaces static training paths with personalized, cross-domain skill development for every builder in the AWS technical field. Powered by a structured skill graph, persistent learner profiles, and the Specialist Knowledge Vault, the Learning Agent delivers adaptive learning journeys via a custom console, in Kiro, Claude, Quick and wherever builders work. Intelligent Routing Agent - A new AI-driven routing engine that matches 136K+ annual specialist requests to verified domain experts using validated skill profiles rather than manually maintained lists - reducing resolution time (currently 7.72 days) and enabling precision matching at scale. Technical Field Community (TFC) Hub - The platform powering 46 Technical Field Communities, managing member engagement, competency tracking, learning path orchestration, and community-driven content curation across AWS's specialist network. Service 360 - A GenAI summarization and prioritization engine that aggregates customer feedback signals (PFRs, SpecReqs, SFDC Opportunity data) into categorized, prioritized service recommendations - automating what was previously a manual closed-loop feedback process to influence the roadmap for AWS public service teams. This is a high-impact, AI-first engineering role where you will build agentic systems, ship production GenAI features, and solve hard problems at the intersection of knowledge graphs, multi-agent orchestration, LLM-powered personalization, and retrieval-augmented generation - all at AWS scale, using the very AI services AWS builds for its customers. Key job responsibilities Design and implement production agentic AI systems using LLMs, knowledge graphs, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration - delivering personalized learning paths and intelligent expert-matching to thousands of field members daily. Build and optimize GenAI-powered pipelines including summarization, content ranking, skill assessment, and intelligent routing - ensuring low latency, high quality, and cost efficiency at scale. Develop and iterate on prompt engineering strategies, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails for production LLM systems - ensuring quality, safety, and reliability. Implement embedding and retrieval strategies for a knowledge base optimizing how domain expertise is indexed, retrieved, and contextualized for agent consumption. Design and build scalable distributed systems and APIs that power the TFC Hub platform, serving thousands of community members across 46 technical domains. Drive operational excellence for production services - owning CI/CD, monitoring, alarming, on-call, and incident response for systems serving thousands of daily users. Contribute to technical strategy and architecture decisions, proactively identifying opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, and developer velocity. Collaborate with Product Management, Science, and field stakeholders to translate ambiguous customer problems into well-scoped technical solutions. About the team You will be joining a high-growth engineering organization that is at the forefront of applying generative AI and agentic technologies to transform how AWS field teams operate. The pace of innovation is high, the problems are ambiguous, and the impact is measured across thousands of field team members and the customers they serve. This role offers the opportunity to shape how teams consume and act on AI-powered tools - building systems from the ground up that define the future of specialist expertise at AWS. About AWS Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. Spektr is Amazon Ads' exabyte-scale central data lake: the unified catalog for petabytes of campaign, ad-serving, billing, and measurement data. Hundreds of teams and Amazon's advertiser-facing AI agents depend on it for discovery, ingestion, transformation, and querying at scale. If you want large-scale engineering with tangible business impact, this is the team. We're rebuilding Spektr ground-up with an AI-first architecture, and building fully-automated domain agents that let customers manage their big data lifecycle in a single click. In parallel, we're adopting Apache Iceberg / S3 Tables with serverless compute, scaling horizontally via a data mesh pattern for 5× growth in volume and demand. You will also drive deployment automation, replacing manual release cycles with CI/CD pipelines that accelerate delivery velocity for a platform serving Tier-1 advertising data systems. Bring your coding skills and your drive to innovate, and help us engineer the next generation of sovereign cloud operations. The M365 Sovereign Clouds organization exists to ensure that sovereign and government cloud customers have access to the same world-class productivity tools that power organizations around the globe, delivered with the highest standards of security, compliance, and operational excellence. We own and operate Microsoft 365 services including Office 365, Exchange, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Purview, Information Protection, PSTN, Office Online, Office Services, and are actively bringing CoPilot to sovereign environments. As part of Azure Silver and Microsoft Sovereign Clouds, our mission is to make secure collaboration accessible, reliable, and performant for those who need it most. We are guided by a commitment to growth mindset, innovation, collaboration, and inclusion, values that shape how we build, operate, and support our services every day. The work we do directly impacts the ability of our customers and their organizations to achieve more. We operate the systems that stand between adversaries and some of the most sensitive communications in the world, including Exchange Online Protection, Exchange Transport, and Microsoft Defender for Office. Our Purview Platform delivers the tools that enable customers to classify, label, protect, and govern their data across the M365 ecosystem. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Creator Marketplace
jobs.description: At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us. ABOUT THIS ROLE As a Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to research, define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools and systems that you need to succeed. You’ll be essential in ensuring the team can reach their potential; working closely with them, reviewing their work, mentoring, and supporting them to develop. Together, you’ll build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice. ABOUT THE TEAM This is an opportunity to join a growing team in a brand new Audible hub in Culver City, Los Angeles. Audible’s Creator Marketplace customers are talented storytellers, voice actors, producers, publishers and our internal content teams. Our teams build innovative tools to automate the entire content production pipeline that lets the experts focus on creation while helping them bring their art to millions of listeners. We are customer obsessed and the tools we build are intuitive & easy to use, and ensure that technology aids the creativity to provide the best in class experience to listeners. By focusing on our creators, we also create value to Audible’s global consumers by helping them to discover new content, talent and stories they love and share. True to Audible's People Principles, we are committed to the success of our people. We define success as not only career advancement but also personal growth and well-being. We actively support our employees through various programs, including mentoring and coaching opportunities, training initiatives, and flexible work arrangements that promote a healthy work-life balance. At Audible, we cherish the diverse backgrounds and perspectives within our team, recognizing that they are essential for fostering robust conversations and finding the right solutions for our customers. We encourage each individual to bring their unique experiences to the table, knowing that diversity fuels our creativity, enriches our collaborative efforts, and leads to better outcomes. By embracing differing viewpoints, we unlock the full potential of our team and create a culture of inclusion and respect. We have exciting opportunities that will challenge you to leverage your technical expertise and make a significant impact. As a technical role model and high-impact contributor, you will have the chance to work alongside a team of exceptionally talented individuals who share your passion for innovation and success. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Leo Telemetry Platform
jobs.description: Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity. Are you passionate about developing mission-critical software systems? As part of the Atlas team, you'll build and maintain the backbone software infrastructure that powers our entire organization. Your work will include: - Creating systems and services for ingesting, processing, and visualizing vast amounts of satellite telemetry data - Building real-time monitoring systems to identify anomalies, detect emerging trends, and proactively alert stakeholders to critical situations that require intervention - Ensuring extremely high reliability, uptime, and performance across systems that receive and manage telemetry streams from thousands of endpoint The systems we build serve a fundamental role in the successful functioning of the satellite constellation, and several supporting teams. They depend on us to have mission-critical reliability, uptime, and performance. Key job responsibilities - Develop software systems that meet the mission criteria and requirements. - Collaborate with your fellow team members to form a strong foundation for a software organization in Leo. - Help on-board new team members. - Utilize AWS and other Amazon technologies to build high-available software services. Export Control Requirement Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. About the team The Atlas software engineering group is responsible for developing and maintaining the critical software infrastructure that enables multi-region telemetry data ingestion, health monitoring, and trend analysis across Amazon's Leo systems.
